verses.original: ה֗וֹי גֵּאוּת֙ עֲטֶ֤רֶת אֶפְרַ֔יִם שִׁכֹּרֵ֣י נֹבֵ֖ל וְצִ֥יץ צְבִ֣י תִפְאַרְתּ֑וֹ אֲשֶׁ֛ר עַל־ רֹ֥אשׁ שְׁמָנִ֖ים גֵּֽיא־ הֲל֥וּמֵי יָֽיִן׃
verses.transliteration: hō·w gê·’ūṯ ‘ă·ṭe·reṯ ’ep̄·ra·yim šik·kō·rê nō·ḇêl wə·ṣîṣ ṣə·ḇî ṯip̄·’ar·tōw ’ă·šer ‘al- rōš šə·mā·nîm gê- hă·lū·mê yā·yin
verses.literal: Woe to the majestic crown of Ephraim’s drunkards to the fading flower of his glorious splendor set on the summit above the fertile valley [the pride] of those overcome by wine

verses.original: הִנֵּ֨ה לַֽאדֹנָ֔י חָזָ֤ק וְאַמִּץ֙ כְּזֶ֥רֶם בָּרָ֖ד קָ֑טֶב שַׂ֣עַר כְּ֠זֶרֶם מַ֣יִם כַּבִּירִ֥ים שֹׁטְפִ֛ים הִנִּ֥יחַ בְּיָֽד׃ לָאָ֖רֶץ
verses.transliteration: hin·nêh la·ḏō·nāy ḥā·zāq wə·’am·miṣ kə·ze·rem bā·rāḏ qā·ṭeḇ śa·‘ar kə·ze·rem ma·yim kab·bî·rîm šō·ṭə·p̄îm hin·nî·aḥ bə·yāḏ lā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: Behold the Lord [has one ] [who is] strong and mighty vvv Like a hailstorm or destructive tempest like a driving rain . . . or flooding downpour . . . he will smash [that crown] . . . to the ground

verses.original: גֵּא֖וּת עֲטֶ֥רֶת אֶפְרָֽיִם׃ שִׁכּוֹרֵ֥י תֵּֽרָמַ֑סְנָה בְּרַגְלַ֖יִם
verses.transliteration: gê·’ūṯ ‘ă·ṭe·reṯ ’ep̄·rā·yim šik·kō·w·rê tê·rā·mas·nāh bə·raḡ·la·yim
verses.literal: The majestic crown of Ephraim’s drunkards will be trampled underfoot . . .

verses.original: נֹבֵל֙ צִיצַ֤ת צְבִ֣י תִפְאַרְתּ֔וֹ אֲשֶׁ֥ר עַל־ רֹ֖אשׁ שְׁמָנִ֑ים גֵּ֣יא וְֽהָ֨יְתָ֜ה כְּבִכּוּרָהּ֙ בְּטֶ֣רֶם קַ֔יִץ אֲשֶׁ֨ר יִרְאֶ֤ה הָֽרֹאֶה֙ אוֹתָ֔הּ בְּעוֹדָ֥הּ בְּכַפּ֖וֹ יִבְלָעֶֽנָּה׃ס
verses.transliteration: nō·ḇêl ṣî·ṣaṯ ṣə·ḇî ṯip̄·’ar·tōw ’ă·šer ‘al- rōš šə·mā·nîm gê wə·hā·yə·ṯāh kə·ḇik·kū·rå̄h bə·ṭe·rem qa·yiṣ ’ă·šer yir·’eh hā·rō·’eh ’ō·w·ṯāh bə·‘ō·w·ḏāh bə·ḵap·pōw yiḇ·lā·‘en·nāh
verses.literal: The fading flower of his beautiful splendor [set] on the summit above the fertile valley will be like a ripe fig before the summer harvest - Whoever sees it - will take it in his hand [and] swallow it

verses.original: הַה֗וּא בַּיּ֣וֹם יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת יִֽהְיֶה֙ לַעֲטֶ֣רֶת צְבִ֔י וְלִצְפִירַ֖ת תִּפְאָרָ֑ה לִשְׁאָ֖ר עַמּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ha·hū bay·yō·wm Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ yih·yeh la·‘ă·ṭe·reṯ ṣə·ḇî wə·liṣ·p̄î·raṯ tip̄·’ā·rāh liš·’ār ‘am·mōw
verses.literal: On that day the LORD of Hosts will be a crown of glory a diadem of splendor to the remnant of His people

verses.original: וּלְר֖וּחַ מִשְׁפָּ֑ט לַיּוֹשֵׁב֙ עַל־ הַמִּשְׁפָּ֔ט וְלִ֨גְבוּרָ֔ה מְשִׁיבֵ֥י מִלְחָמָ֖ה שָֽׁעְרָה׃ס
verses.transliteration: ū·lə·rū·aḥ miš·pāṭ lay·yō·wō·šêḇ ‘al- ham·miš·pāṭ wə·liḡ·ḇū·rāh mə·šî·ḇê mil·ḥā·māh šā·‘ə·rāh
verses.literal: a spirit of justice to him who sits in judgment and a strength to those who repel the onslaught at the gate

verses.original: אֵ֙לֶּה֙ וְגַם־ שָׁג֔וּ בַּיַּ֣יִן תָּע֑וּ וּבַשֵּׁכָ֖ר כֹּהֵ֣ן וְנָבִיא֩ שָׁג֨וּ בַשֵּׁכָ֜ר נִבְלְע֣וּ מִן־ הַיַּ֗יִן תָּעוּ֙ מִן־ הַשֵּׁכָ֔ר שָׁגוּ֙ בָּֽרֹאֶ֔ה פָּק֖וּ פְּלִילִיָּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ’êl·leh wə·ḡam- šā·ḡū bay·ya·yin tā·‘ū ū·ḇaš·šê·ḵār kō·hên wə·nā·ḇî šā·ḡū ḇaš·šê·ḵār niḇ·lə·‘ū min- hay·ya·yin tā·‘ū min- haš·šê·ḵār šā·ḡū bā·rō·’eh pā·qū pə·lî·lî·yāh
verses.literal: These also stagger from wine and stumble from strong drink Priests and prophets reel from strong drink and are befuddled by wine They stumble because of strong drink muddled in their visions and stumbling in their judgments

verses.original: כִּ֚י כָּל־ שֻׁלְחָנ֔וֹת מָלְא֖וּ קִ֣יא מָקֽוֹם׃ס בְּלִ֖י צֹאָ֑ה
verses.transliteration: kî kāl- šul·ḥā·nō·wṯ mā·lə·’ū qî mā·qō·wm bə·lî ṣō·’āh
verses.literal: For all their tables are covered with vomit there is not a place without filth

verses.original: אֶת־ מִי֙ יוֹרֶ֣ה דֵעָ֔ה וְאֶת־ מִ֖י יָבִ֣ין שְׁמוּעָ֑ה גְּמוּלֵי֙ מֵֽחָלָ֔ב עַתִּיקֵ֖י מִשָּׁדָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: ’eṯ- mî yō·w·reh ḏê·‘āh wə·’eṯ- mî yā·ḇîn šə·mū·‘āh gə·mū·lê mê·ḥā·lāḇ ‘at·tî·qê miš·šā·ḏā·yim
verses.literal: - Whom is He trying to teach . . . - To whom is He explaining His message To infants just weaned from milk To babies removed from the breast

verses.original: כִּ֣י צַ֤ו לָצָו֙ צַ֣ו לָצָ֔ו קַ֥ו לָקָ֖ו קַ֣ו לָקָ֑ו זְעֵ֥יר שָׁ֖ם זְעֵ֥יר שָֽׁם׃
verses.transliteration: kî ṣaw lā·ṣāw ṣaw lā·ṣāw qaw lā·qāw qaw lā·qāw zə·‘êr šām zə·‘êr šām
verses.literal: For [they hear] Order on order order on order line on line line on line a little here a little there

verses.original: כִּ֚י בְּלַעֲגֵ֣י שָׂפָ֔ה אַחֶ֑רֶת וּבְלָשׁ֖וֹן יְדַבֵּ֖ר אֶל־ הַזֶּֽה׃ הָעָ֥ם
verses.transliteration: kî bə·la·‘ă·ḡê śā·p̄āh ’a·ḥe·reṯ ū·ḇə·lā·šō·wn yə·ḏab·bêr ’el- haz·zeh hā·‘ām
verses.literal: Indeed with mocking lips and foreign tongues He will speak to this people

verses.original: אֲשֶׁ֣ר׀ אָמַ֣ר אֲלֵיהֶ֗ם זֹ֤את הַמְּנוּחָה֙ לֶֽעָיֵ֔ף הָנִ֣יחוּ וְזֹ֖את הַמַּרְגֵּעָ֑ה אָב֖וּא וְלֹ֥א שְׁמֽוֹעַ׃
verses.transliteration: ’ă·šer ’ā·mar ’ă·lê·hem zōṯ ham·mə·nū·ḥāh le·‘ā·yêp̄ hā·nî·ḥū wə·zōṯ ham·mar·gê·‘āh ’ā·ḇū wə·lō šə·mō·w·a‘
verses.literal: to whom He has said - This is the place of rest let the weary rest this is the place of repose But they would not listen

verses.original: דְּבַר־ יְהוָ֗ה לָהֶ֜ם וְהָיָ֨ה צַ֣ו לָצָ֞ו צַ֤ו לָצָו֙ קַ֤ו לָקָו֙ קַ֣ו לָקָ֔ו זְעֵ֥יר שָׁ֖ם זְעֵ֣יר שָׁ֑ם לְמַ֨עַן יֵלְכ֜וּ וְכָשְׁל֤וּ אָחוֹר֙ וְנִשְׁבָּ֔רוּ וְנוֹקְשׁ֖וּ וְנִלְכָּֽדוּ׃פ
verses.transliteration: də·ḇar- Yah·weh lā·hem wə·hā·yāh ṣaw lā·ṣāw ṣaw lā·ṣāw qaw lā·qāw qaw lā·qāw zə·‘êr šām zə·‘êr šām lə·ma·‘an yê·lə·ḵū wə·ḵā·šə·lū ’ā·ḥō·wr wə·niš·bā·rū wə·nō·wq·šū wə·nil·kā·ḏū
verses.literal: Then the word of the LORD to them will become Order on order order on order line on line line on line a little here a little there so that they will go stumbling backward and will be injured ensnared and captured

verses.original: לָכֵ֛ן שִׁמְע֥וּ דְבַר־ יְהוָ֖ה אַנְשֵׁ֣י לָצ֑וֹן מֹֽשְׁלֵי֙ הַזֶּ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֖ר הָעָ֣ם בִּירוּשָׁלִָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên šim·‘ū ḏə·ḇar- Yah·weh ’an·šê lā·ṣō·wn mō·šə·lê haz·zeh ’ă·šer hā·‘ām bî·rū·šā·lim
verses.literal: Therefore hear the word of the LORD O scoffers who rule this - people in Jerusalem

verses.original: כִּ֣י אֲמַרְתֶּ֗ם כָּרַ֤תְנֽוּ בְרִית֙ אֶת־ מָ֔וֶת עָשִׂ֣ינוּ חֹזֶ֑ה שִׁיט וְעִם־ שְׁא֖וֹל כִּֽי־ שׁוֹטֵ֤ף עָבַר לֹ֣א יְבוֹאֵ֔נוּ כִּ֣י שַׂ֧מְנוּ כָזָ֛ב מַחְסֵ֖נוּ וּבַשֶּׁ֥קֶר נִסְתָּֽרְנוּ׃ס
verses.transliteration: kî ’ă·mar·tem kā·raṯ·nū ḇə·rîṯ ’eṯ- mā·weṯ ‘ā·śî·nū ḥō·zeh šīṭ wə·‘im- šə·’ō·wl kî- šō·w·ṭêp̄ ʿå̄·ḇar lō yə·ḇō·w·’ê·nū kî śam·nū ḵā·zāḇ maḥ·sê·nū ū·ḇaš·še·qer nis·tā·rə·nū
verses.literal: For you said We have made a covenant with death we have fashioned an agreement . . . with Sheol When the overwhelming scourge passes through it will not touch us because we have made lies our refuge and falsehood our hiding place

verses.original: לָכֵ֗ן כֹּ֤ה אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֔ה אָמַר֙ הִנְנִ֛י יִסַּ֥ד אָ֑בֶן בְּצִיּ֖וֹן בֹּ֜חַן אֶ֣בֶן יִקְרַת֙ פִּנַּ֤ת מוּסָּ֔ד מוּסָ֣ד הַֽמַּאֲמִ֖ין לֹ֥א יָחִֽישׁ׃
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên kōh ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh ’ā·mar hin·nî yis·saḏ ’ā·ḇen bə·ṣî·yō·wn bō·ḥan ’e·ḇen yiq·raṯ pin·naṯ mūs·sāḏ mū·sāḏ ham·ma·’ă·mîn lō yā·ḥîš
verses.literal: So this is what the Lord GOD says See I lay a stone in Zion a tested stone a precious cornerstone a sure foundation the one who believes will never be shaken

verses.original: וְשַׂמְתִּ֤י מִשְׁפָּט֙ לְקָ֔ו וּצְדָקָ֖ה לְמִשְׁקָ֑לֶת בָרָד֙ וְיָעָ֤ה מַחְסֵ֣ה כָזָ֔ב מַ֖יִם יִשְׁטֹֽפוּ׃ וְסֵ֥תֶר
verses.transliteration: wə·śam·tî miš·pāṭ lə·qāw ū·ṣə·ḏā·qāh lə·miš·qā·leṯ ḇā·rāḏ wə·yā·‘āh maḥ·sêh ḵā·zāḇ ma·yim yiš·ṭō·p̄ū wə·sê·ṯer
verses.literal: I will make justice the measuring line and righteousness the level Hail will sweep away your refuge of lies and water will flood your hiding place

verses.original: בְּרִֽיתְכֶם֙ אֶת־ מָ֔וֶת וְכֻפַּ֤ר וְחָזוּתְכֶ֥ם אֶת־ שְׁא֖וֹל לֹ֣א תָק֑וּם כִּ֣י שׁוֹטֵף֙ שׁ֤וֹט יַֽעֲבֹ֔ר וִהְיִ֥יתֶם ל֖וֹ לְמִרְמָֽס׃
verses.transliteration: bə·rî·ṯə·ḵem ’eṯ- mā·weṯ wə·ḵup·par wə·ḥā·zū·ṯə·ḵem ’eṯ- šə·’ō·wl lō ṯā·qūm kî šō·w·ṭêp̄ šō·wṭ ya·‘ă·ḇōr wih·yî·ṯem lōw lə·mir·mās
verses.literal: Your covenant with death will be dissolved and your agreement with Sheol will not stand When the overwhelming scourge passes through you will be trampled by it

verses.original: מִדֵּ֤י עָבְרוֹ֙ יִקַּ֣ח אֶתְכֶ֔ם כִּֽי־ יַעֲבֹ֖ר בַבֹּ֧קֶר בַּבֹּ֛קֶר בַּיּ֣וֹם וּבַלָּ֑יְלָה וְהָיָ֥ה הָבִ֥ין שְׁמוּעָֽה׃ רַק־ זְוָעָ֖ה
verses.transliteration: mid·dê ‘ā·ḇə·rōw yiq·qaḥ ’eṯ·ḵem kî- ya·‘ă·ḇōr ḇab·bō·qer bab·bō·qer bay·yō·wm ū·ḇal·lā·yə·lāh wə·hā·yāh hā·ḇîn šə·mū·‘āh raq- zə·wā·‘āh
verses.literal: As often as it passes through it will carry you away - - it will sweep through morning after morning by day and by night . . . The understanding of [this] message [will bring] sheer terror

verses.original: כִּֽי־ הַמַּצָּ֖ע קָצַ֥ר מֵֽהִשְׂתָּרֵ֑עַ וְהַמַּסֵּכָ֥ה צָ֖רָה כְּהִתְכַּנֵּֽס׃
verses.transliteration: kî- ham·maṣ·ṣā‘ qā·ṣar mê·hiś·tā·rê·a‘ wə·ham·mas·sê·ḵāh ṣā·rāh kə·hiṯ·kan·nês
verses.literal: Indeed the bed is too short to stretch out on and the blanket too small to wrap around you

verses.original: כִּ֤י יְהוָ֔ה יָק֣וּם כְהַר־ פְּרָצִים֙ יִרְגָּ֑ז כְּעֵ֖מֶק בְּגִבְע֣וֹן לַעֲשׂ֤וֹת מַעֲשֵׂ֙הוּ֙ זָ֣ר מַעֲשֵׂ֔הוּ וְלַֽעֲבֹד֙ עֲבֹ֣דָת֔וֹ נָכְרִיָּ֖ה עֲבֹדָתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: kî Yah·weh yā·qūm ḵə·har- pə·rā·ṣîm yir·gāz kə·‘ê·meq bə·ḡiḇ·‘ō·wn la·‘ă·śō·wṯ ma·‘ă·śê·hū zār ma·‘ă·śê·hū wə·la·‘ă·ḇōḏ ‘ă·ḇō·ḏā·ṯōw nā·ḵə·rî·yāh ‘ă·ḇō·ḏā·ṯōw
verses.literal: For the LORD will rise up as at Mount Perazim He will rouse Himself as [in] the Valley of Gibeon to do His work His strange work and to perform His task His disturbing task

verses.original: וְעַתָּה֙ אַל־ תִּתְלוֹצָ֔צוּ פֶּֽן־ מֽוֹסְרֵיכֶ֑ם יֶחְזְק֖וּ כִּֽי־ שָׁמַ֗עְתִּי מֵאֵ֨ת אֲדֹנָ֧י יְהוִ֛ה צְבָא֖וֹת וְנֶחֱרָצָ֜ה כָלָ֨ה עַל־ כָּל־ הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘at·tāh ’al- tiṯ·lō·w·ṣā·ṣū pen- mō·ws·rê·ḵem yeḥ·zə·qū kî- šā·ma‘·tî mê·’êṯ ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ wə·ne·ḥĕ·rā·ṣāh ḵā·lāh ‘al- kāl- hā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: So now do not mock or your shackles will become heavier Indeed I have heard - from the Lord GOD of Hosts a decree of destruction against the whole land

verses.original: הַאֲזִ֥ינוּ וְשִׁמְע֖וּ קוֹלִ֑י הַקְשִׁ֥יבוּ וְשִׁמְע֖וּ אִמְרָתִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: ha·’ă·zî·nū wə·šim·‘ū qō·w·lî haq·šî·ḇū wə·šim·‘ū ’im·rā·ṯî
verses.literal: Listen and hear my voice Pay attention and hear what I say

verses.original: יַחֲרֹ֥שׁ הַחֹרֵ֖שׁ לִזְרֹ֑עַ הֲכֹ֣ל הַיּ֔וֹם יְפַתַּ֥ח וִֽישַׂדֵּ֖ד אַדְמָתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ya·ḥă·rōš ha·ḥō·rêš liz·rō·a‘ hă·ḵōl hay·yō·wm yə·p̄at·taḥ wî·śad·dêḏ ’aḏ·mā·ṯōw
verses.literal: Does the plowman plow for planting every day Does he continuously loosen and harrow the soil

verses.original: אִם־ שִׁוָּ֣ה פָנֶ֔יהָ הֲלוֹא֙ יִזְרֹ֑ק קֶ֖צַח וְהֵפִ֥יץ וְכַמֹּ֣ן וְשָׂ֨ם חִטָּ֤ה שׂוֹרָה֙ וּשְׂעֹרָ֣ה נִסְמָ֔ן וְכֻסֶּ֖מֶת גְּבֻלָתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ’im- šiw·wāh p̄ā·ne·hā hă·lō·w yiz·rōq qe·ṣaḥ wə·hê·p̄îṣ wə·ḵam·mōn wə·śām ḥiṭ·ṭāh śō·w·rāh ū·śə·‘ō·rāh nis·mān wə·ḵus·se·meṯ gə·ḇu·lā·ṯōw
verses.literal: When he has leveled its surface does he not sow caraway and scatter cumin He plants wheat in rows and barley in plots and rye within its border

verses.original: אֱלֹהָ֥יו וְיִסְּר֥וֹ יוֹרֶֽנּוּ׃ לַמִּשְׁפָּ֖ט
verses.transliteration: ’ĕ·lō·hāw wə·yis·sə·rōw yō·w·ren·nū lam·miš·pāṭ
verses.literal: For his God instructs and teaches him properly

verses.original: כִּ֣י קֶ֔צַח לֹ֤א י֣וּדַשׁ בֶֽחָרוּץ֙ וְאוֹפַ֣ן עֲגָלָ֔ה יוּסָּ֑ב עַל־ כַּמֹּ֖ן כִּ֧י קֶ֖צַח יֵחָ֥בֶט בַמַּטֶּ֛ה וְכַמֹּ֥ן בַּשָּֽׁבֶט׃
verses.transliteration: kî qe·ṣaḥ lō yū·ḏaš ḇe·ḥā·rūṣ wə·’ō·w·p̄an ‘ă·ḡā·lāh yūs·sāḇ ‘al- kam·mōn kî qe·ṣaḥ yê·ḥā·ḇeṭ ḇam·maṭ·ṭeh wə·ḵam·mōn baš·šā·ḇeṭ
verses.literal: Surely caraway is not threshed with a sledge and the wheel of a cart is not rolled over the cumin But caraway is beaten out with a stick and cumin with a rod

verses.original: לֶ֣חֶם יוּדָ֔ק כִּ֛י לֹ֥א יְדוּשֶׁ֑נּוּ לָנֶ֖צַח אָד֣וֹשׁ גִּלְגַּ֧ל עֶגְלָת֛וֹ וְ֠הָמַם וּפָרָשָׁ֖יו לֹֽא־ יְדֻקֶּֽנּוּ׃
verses.transliteration: le·ḥem yū·ḏāq kî lō yə·ḏū·šen·nū lā·ne·ṣaḥ ’ā·ḏō·wōš gil·gal ‘eḡ·lā·ṯōw wə·hā·mam ū·p̄ā·rā·šāw lō- yə·ḏuq·qen·nū
verses.literal: Grain for bread must be ground but it is not endlessly threshed . . . . . . Though the wheels of the cart roll over it the horses do not crush it

verses.original: זֹ֕את גַּם־ יָצָ֑אָה מֵעִ֛ם יְהוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת הִפְלִ֣יא עֵצָ֔ה הִגְדִּ֖יל תּוּשִׁיָּֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: zōṯ gam- yā·ṣā·’āh mê·‘im Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ hip̄·lî ‘ê·ṣāh hiḡ·dîl tū·šî·yāh
verses.literal: This also comes from the LORD of Hosts [who] is wonderful in counsel [and] excellent in wisdom
